title: Appliance Rebates in Vaughan 2026: Up to $200 Per Appliance
desc: Vaughan appliance rebates for 2026: $25 to $200 under Home Renovation Savings for ENERGY STAR Most Efficient replacements, with Alectra Utilities as distributor.
lead: Vaughan has 103,910 households, 86% of them owners and 63% in detached homes. Appliance rebates fit a house where one appliance fails at a time.
cards_heading: What Ontario pays for new appliances in Vaughan
cards_intro: We re-read the program's appliance page on October 4, 2026. The rebates are province-wide, so the amounts are the same in every city, and the rules about what you replace and which model you buy are what decide a claim.

cards.title: Heat pump clothes dryer
cards.note: The largest of the six appliance rebates, for a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient heat pump dryer replacing an electric dryer.

cards.title: Induction cooktop or range
cards.note: For a new induction cooktop or range on the program's product list, replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Washing machine
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient washer on the program list.

cards.title: Fridge
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient refrigerator replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Freezer
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient freezer on the list.

cards.title: Dishwasher
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient dishwasher on the list.

cards.title: Who can claim
cards.note: A residential customer on the Ontario grid with an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. Cornwall Electric customers are excluded.

cards.title: Free route
cards.note: Income-qualified households can get energy-efficient fridges and freezers at no charge, along with other upgrades.

after_cards: The appliance page states no end date, so confirm it is still open before you buy.
sections: 65,040 Vaughan households live in detached houses. Whatever their age, the rebate asks for an existing electric appliance that needs replacing, not for a working one to be swapped early.

Alectra Utilities supplies power and Vaughan postal codes begin with L, which the Energy Affordability Program lists for free fridges and freezers. The renter share is 14%, the lowest among our Toronto-area cities.
Buy new, then upload the receipt

Buy a new appliance from any retailer, then upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase. Used and refurbished units do not qualify. Keep the receipt, the model number and the delivery date together. Vaughan households who buy during a sale should still confirm the model is on the list at the time they check out.

Unlike the thermostat rebate, the appliance page lists no home type. It asks for a residential customer on the Ontario grid. It does not address condos or apartments directly, so a Vaughan condo owner or tenant should confirm with the program. 14% of Vaughan households rent, and a tenant should ask the landlord before swapping a fridge or range that came with the unit.

About 8% of Vaughan's 103,910 households live in homes built before 1981. Age of the house tells you little about the age of the fridge, and a working appliance rarely pays back a swap through a $25 to $200 rebate alone. The rebate suits a replacement you already need to make.
Most Efficient, not just ENERGY STAR

The rebate is for ENERGY STAR Most Efficient models, which the page describes as going beyond standard ENERGY STAR requirements. A fridge with the ordinary ENERGY STAR mark may not qualify. Each appliance has its own product list linked from the program page, so find the model number there before you pay, whether you buy in Vaughan or online.
claim_steps: Check that the appliance you are replacing is electric and that you are on the Ontario grid.
Find a new model on the program's ENERGY STAR Most Efficient list for that appliance.
Buy it new from any retailer and keep the receipt.
Upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase.
If your household income is under the limits, call 1-844-770-3148 about free fridges and freezers first.
faq: Does Alectra offer an appliance rebate in Vaughan?
Do I need receipts for each appliance?
Yes, each claim is a separate upload within 60 days.
Can I claim a cooktop and a range?
They are one category, induction cooktops and ranges, at $150 each claim.
